findings.evidence: 1/3 HTML pages affected (33.3%). Each has under 60 words of body text with 5 or more scripts.
findings.mechanism: A response carrying many script tags but little text is the signature of a client-rendered application shell. A fetcher that does not execute scripts receives no substance to extract or quote.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Content becomes extractable without a browser.
steps: Confirm with `curl -s URL` that the body copy is absent.
Enable server-side rendering or static generation for these routes.
suggested_action.summary: Deliver the main content in the server response for these routes.
suggested_action.verification: Raw HTML contains the body copy; check clears.

findings.title: Pages return almost no body text in the raw HTML response

findings.evidence: 1/3 HTML pages affected (33.3%). Images named for pricing, hours or specs lack alt text and the page carries under 250 words.
findings.mechanism: A price list, spec table or opening-hours panel rendered as an image is invisible to text extraction. With no alt text and little surrounding copy, the fact simply does not exist for the machine.

steps: Replace image-rendered price lists and spec sheets with HTML tables holding the same values.
Give every content-bearing image descriptive alt text stating the fact it conveys.
Keep images as visual reinforcement, not as the sole carrier.
suggested_action.summary: Restate every fact currently carried only by an image as real HTML text.
suggested_action.verification: Re-run the audit; the check clears.

findings.title: Fact-bearing images carry no alt text on text-sparse pages

findings.mechanism: The H1 is the strongest in-page statement of what a document is about. Without it, chunking and topic assignment fall back to the title tag or to guesswork over body text.

steps: Add a single descriptive H1 per template.
Do not use the site name as the H1 on interior pages.
suggested_action.summary: Give every page exactly one H1 stating its subject.
suggested_action.verification: Every crawled page reports one H1.

findings.title: Many pages have no H1 heading

findings.mechanism: Several competing top-level headings make the document's primary subject ambiguous, which weakens chunk-to-topic assignment.

steps: Keep one H1 per page and rank the rest beneath it.
suggested_action.summary: Demote secondary H1 elements to H2.

findings.title: Many pages declare multiple H1 headings

findings.mechanism: Without a <main> element or role="main", an extractor cannot separate body copy from navigation and footer boilerplate, so chunks are diluted with repeated site furniture.

suggested_action.expected_impact: Cleaner extraction with less boilerplate diluting each chunk.
steps: Add <main> around body content in each template.
suggested_action.summary: Wrap the unique page content in a <main> element.
suggested_action.verification: Main landmark present on most pages.

findings.title: Pages provide no main content landmark

inconclusive.reason: No headless browser available on this run, so raw and rendered text could not be compared. Install Playwright to evaluate this check. A static-HTML proxy check was run instead (MR-EMPTY-SHELL).
